nodes.klein: to cling, cleave, adhere. he clung, cleaved, adhered, joined, was attached. he pasted, glued together. he was joined, was attached; was contagious. he stuck, glued together; he caused to adhere. was stuck, was glued together. הִתְדַּבֵּק NH he clung, was joined together. he caused to cling; he infected (with disease); he overtook; he followed hard after, pursued. was made to cleave, was stuck.
